reviewer: same-session independent subagent; not organizationally independent
scope: market source, development controls, and independent limiting cases only until parent declares the primary protocol frozen

invariants.oracle: opening cash + collected modeled invoices + explicit external finance - cash-paid operating expenses - construction outlays - maintenance - refunds - other cash outflows = closing cash
opening receivables + accepted invoices - collections - refunds/credit notes applied to unpaid invoices - writeoffs = closing receivables

invariants.claim: No earned revenue on rejected work
invariants.oracle: a rejection creates no accepted invoice; any modeled advance must be separately recorded and refunded/forfeited only under an explicit contract

invariants.claim: No seed capital in earned surplus
invariants.oracle: seed and any external injections are financing; accumulated earned surplus excludes them and cannot finance an earned-surplus claim
at each investment timestamp, liquid uncommitted cash covers construction plus required reserves; invoices not yet collected cannot fund it
each resource or liability has one identity; paid/expense/accrual/cash projections state their basis and do not subtract the same liability twice
canonical-ledger simulated invoice and receipt events do not use revenue/collected with observed basis; actual collections remain zero or unknown
an offer worse or equal in every buyer-relevant dimension and strictly worse in at least one is never selected when the dominating option is available and feasible
all nonpositive net-utility feasible offers lead to defer/do-nothing, absent an explicitly documented positive tie rule
B and C with identical measured attributes, investment costs, initial resources, information, policy and external draws produce identical outcomes

invariants.claim: No quality bonus for asset admission
invariants.oracle: quality, coverage and customer effort may change only through measured production evidence or separately labeled assumptions; asset identity alone never raises utility or revenue
candidate/protocol/choice models/investment policies/scenario grids and seeds are frozen before inspecting primary results; controls and corrections are separately labeled
A/B/C external buyer arrivals, valuation draws, shocks and payer behavior are aligned by stable semantic IDs, not consumption-order-dependent RNG state
modeled arrivals are labeled modeled; observed recurring jobs require changed source/version/scope/obligation and cannot be synthesized by repeating an unchanged request
a finite per-period service capacity binds admissions and any load degradation follows the declared model, without overselling impossible completion
enterprise profit, cash gain, cumulative incremental outcome over A, and gross per-use benefit are separate; positive enterprise cash does not imply investment repayment
financed asset hash/identity matches the constructed and freshly tested asset; second investment corresponds to a distinct actually tested retained improvement
wages and advertised software subscription prices cannot identify exact-task durations, WTP, buyer choice coefficients or investment engineering/model costs
competitors cannot promise unlimited capacity and must pay their own changes; conventional providers retain legitimate free software and caches
a finite dynamic behavioral simulation with heuristic competitor reactions is not called Nash, convergent or optimal absent diagnostics/proof

limiting_cases: zero arrivals: no invoices, no collections, no operating receipts; fixed expenses can exhaust funds
zero buyer value or prohibitive price: outside option wins
identical B/C under shared draws: exact tie
no capability effect with positive construction: investment cannot causally improve economics by admission alone
all deliveries rejected: no acceptance revenue; attempted delivery costs remain
collections after horizon: invoices are receivables, never available cash
cash below construction plus reserve: investment denied
cash exactly at construction plus reserve: boundary behavior explicit and reproducible
free competent conventional option with no extra effort/trust/quality deficit: positive-price equivalent AGI offer cannot win
duplicate ledger event: idempotent or rejected; conflicting duplicate rejected
unpaid cost later paid: one economic expense, one cash payment, no double subtraction
post-collection refund: reduces cash and net revenue; invoice cancellation before collection never reduces cash
capacity zero: no service delivered or accepted revenue
infinite-value theoretical buyer does not create unbounded finite capacity
zero unknown authoring cost is a hypothetical sensitivity point, not an all-in measured result
